### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_trade_order_di (DWD): 交易订单明细增量事实表（子订单粒度，同一order_id可能包含多条商品明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID（一单多品时对应多行）
  order_item_id VARCHAR  -- 子订单明细行ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 下单用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  item_id VARCHAR  -- 商品ID
  creator_id VARCHAR  -- 带货达人ID，非达人订单为NULL或空字符串
  order_status VARCHAR  -- 订单状态: paid/shipped/completed/cancelled
  qty INTEGER  -- 购买件数
  gross_amt DOUBLE  -- 应付原价金额
  discount_amt DOUBLE  -- 优惠金额，无优惠时为NULL
  pay_amt DOUBLE  -- 实付金额（取消单为0）
  pay_ts VARCHAR  -- 支付时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，未支付为NULL
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

TABLE dim_user_vip_scd2 (DIM): 用户会员等级变更拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  scd_id VARCHAR  -- 拉链记录ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  vip_tier VARCHAR  -- 会员等级
  growth_score INTEGER  -- 版本期初成长值
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_trade_order_di (DWD): 交易订单明细增量事实表（子订单粒度，同一order_id可能包含多条商品明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID（一单多品时对应多行）
  order_item_id VARCHAR  -- 子订单明细行ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 下单用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  item_id VARCHAR  -- 商品ID
  creator_id VARCHAR  -- 带货达人ID，非达人订单为NULL或空字符串
  order_status VARCHAR  -- 订单状态: paid/shipped/completed/cancelled
  qty INTEGER  -- 购买件数
  gross_amt DOUBLE  -- 应付原价金额
  discount_amt DOUBLE  -- 优惠金额，无优惠时为NULL
  pay_amt DOUBLE  -- 实付金额（取消单为0）
  pay_ts VARCHAR  -- 支付时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，未支付为NULL
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dwd_refund_di (DWD): 售后退款明细增量事实表（同一order_id可能存在多次部分退款）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  refund_id VARCHAR  -- 退款单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_amt DOUBLE  -- 退款金额
  refund_reason VARCHAR  -- 退款原因: quality/size_mismatch/late_delivery/buyer_remorse
  refund_status VARCHAR  -- 退款状态: approved/pending/rejected
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 退款日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

### Linker Schema Notes
GRAIN & FILTERS. dwd_trade_order_di is SUB-ORDER (order_item_id) grain: one order_id can have multiple item rows, so never sum pay_amt after joining other tables. Partition col is ds (YYYYMMDD); use static range ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261012' (do NOT use MAX_PT here; question requires that window). Non-cancelled filter from probe: order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') i.e. order_status <> 'cancelled' (probed values are exactly cancelled/completed/paid/shipped; no invented literals). pay_amt is DOUBLE already in YUAN (no /100 conversion), cancelled rows have pay_amt=0 anyway. pay_ts is VARCHAR 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' and is NULL for unpaid rows (8 nulls in latest partition): require pay_ts IS NOT NULL when joining the SCD2 rate, because tier must be the one effective on the pay date. refer date: SUBSTR(pay_ts,1,10) -> 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

STEP 1 (order to order_id grain): SELECT order_id, shop_id, SUBSTR(pay_ts,1,10) AS pay_dt, SUM(pay_amt) AS order_pay_yuan FROM dwd_trade_order_di WHERE ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261012' AND order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') AND pay_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY order_id, shop_id, SUBSTR(pay_ts,1,10).

STEP 2 (refunds deduped): dwd_refund_di partition col ds, static range ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015'. Warning from probe: the SAME order_id+amount can appear as separate refund_id rows under different statuses (e.g. pending and approved), and a single order can have multiple partial refunds, so (a) filter refund_status = 'approved' (probed literal), (b) first dedupe/aggregate at refund_id grain, e.g. SELECT refund_id, order_id, MAX(refund_amt) AS refund_amt FROM dwd_refund_di WHERE ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015' AND refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_id, order_id, then (c) SUM(refund_amt) per order_id. Do NOT COUNT(*) refund rows and do NOT join approved refunds directly at order grain without collapsing to order_id, otherwise refund (and thus net commission) fans out.

JOIN ORDER: (1) order_agg LEFT JOIN refund_agg ON order_agg.order_id = refund_agg.order_id (refund table joined to the already order-grain order set; use NVL(refund_agg.refund_yuan,0) so orders with no approved refund contribute 0 instead of NULL); (2) then JOIN dim_shop_commission_scd2 c ON c.shop_id = order_agg.shop_id AND order_agg.pay_dt BETWEEN c.eff_start_dt AND c.eff_end_dt. SCD2 slicing: dim_shop_commission_scd2 is UNPARTITIONED (no ds/dt predicate!). eff_start_dt/eff_end_dt are 'YYYY-MM-DD' VARCHAR strings, so plain string comparison against SUBSTR(pay_ts,1,10) is date-format aligned and correct; end date 9999-12-31 marks open ranges. Do NOT filter is_current=1 (that would drop historical tiers); the BETWEEN-on-effective-dates predicate is what picks the tier/rate effective on the pay date. If the BETWEEN can match multiple rows for one shop/day in edge cases, keep the row via ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY c.eff_start_dt DESC) = 1 before aggregating.

RATE / UNIT. comm_rate_bps is INTEGER in BPS (probed range 300-1250, e.g. 300 = 3.00%): convert with /10000.0. Rate varies per shop even inside one contract_tier, so compute commission PER ORDER as (order_pay_yuan - NVL(refund_yuan,0)) * comm_rate_bps/10000.0 and then SUM by contract_tier; never multiply a tier-level aggregate amount by one representative rate. Amounts already in yuan, no other conversion.

FINAL AGGREGATION (group by contract_tier, contract_tier values probed: 'CORE','KA','STD'): gross_pay_yuan = ROUND(SUM(order_pay_yuan),2); refund_yuan = ROUND(SUM(NVL(refund_yuan,0)),2); net_comm_yuan = ROUND(SUM((order_pay_yuan - NVL(refund_yuan,0)) * comm_rate_bps/10000.0),2); ORDER BY contract_tier ASC. Refund amounts for orders outside the 20261001-20261012 paid set are excluded by the join to order_agg (inner join on the order set). ODPS syntax only: SUBSTR, NVL, COALESCE, ROUND, CAST, ROW_NUMBER() OVER, TO_CHAR/TO_DATE if date parsing is needed; no DATE_FORMAT/DATE_ADD/UNIX_TIMESTAMP/IFNULL/2-arg DATEDIFF.

PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)

  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

TABLE dim_user_vip_scd2 (DIM): 用户会员等级变更拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table

  growth_score INTEGER  -- 版本期初成长值
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效开始日

【1. dwd_trade_order_di（订单事实，子订单粒度）】
- 分区：PARTITIONED BY (ds)，ds 为 'YYYYMMDD' 字符串。题目给了明确区间，直接写分区常量：ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261012'（不要用子查询取 MAX_PT，也不需要 MAX_PT，因为区间已指定；若后续改为最新分区，请用 MAX_PT('dwd_trade_order_di')；探查到的最新分区为 '20261015'）。
- 非取消单过滤：order_status 实际存储小写英文枚举 'paid'/'shipped'/'completed'/'cancelled'（已探查确认），因此写 order_status <> 'cancelled'（或 NOT IN ('cancelled')）。注意取消单 pay_amt 为 0、pay_ts 为 NULL，故同时建议 pay_ts IS NOT NULL 以保证能取到支付日用于 SCD2 切片（这是支付日切片的必要约束，不是额外业务过滤）。
- 金额单位：pay_amt 为 DOUBLE，单位已是【元】，不要再 /100。实付按子订单行累加，grain 为 order_item_id。
- 建仓汇总前必须先聚合到订单粒度：SELECT order_id, shop_id, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_yuan, MAX(pay_ts) AS pay_ts FROM dwd_trade_order_di WHERE ds BETWEEN ... AND order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY order_id, shop_id。切勿与退款表在子订单粒度直接 join，否则退款额会按明细行数成倍放大。

【2. dwd_refund_di（退款事实，同一 order_id 可能多次部分退款）】
- 分区：PARTITIONED BY (ds)，写 ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015'（探查到的最新分区为 '20261015'；如需最新可用 MAX_PT('dwd_refund_di')）。
- 状态码：refund_status 实际存储精确字符串 'approved'/'pending'/'rejected'（已探查确认），直接写 refund_status = 'approved'，无需大小写或编码转换。注意同一 order_id、同一金额可能同时存在 pending 与 approved 两条记录，必须按状态过滤后再聚合，避免重复计。
- 金额单位：refund_amt 为 DOUBLE，单位已是【元】，不要再 /100。grain 为 refund_id（明细），必须先聚合：SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amt) AS refund_yuan FROM dwd_refund_di WHERE ds BETWEEN ... AND refund_status='approved' GROUP BY order_id。
- 退款分区窗口（至 20261015）宽于订单窗口，属于正常的退款滞后；用 INNER JOIN（或 LEFT JOIN 后再 COALESCE 为 0，但聚合口径题通常二者等价，推荐 INNER JOIN 订单侧驱动 + LEFT JOIN 退款侧）时以订单表为左表关联，保证只统计订单窗口内订单的退款。

【3. dim_shop_commission_scd2（店铺抽佣费率拉链表，非分区全量维表）】
- 无分区，无需任何分区过滤。
- Point-in-time 切片：按【订单支付日】取生效记录，谓词为 substr(pay_ts,1,10) BETWEEN eff_start_dt AND eff_end_dt。pay_ts 形如 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'，eff_start_dt/eff_end_dt 形如 'YYYY-MM-DD'（如 '2025-01-01'、'9999-12-31'），截取到日级后右侧同为 YYYY-MM-DD 字符串，字典序比较等价于日期比较，安全。切勿把 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' 整串直接与 'YYYY-MM-DD' 边界比较，也切勿用 YYYYMMDD 的 ds 分区值去和 YYYY-MM-DD 的生效日期比较（格式不一致会静默丢数）。
- 严禁加 is_current = 1 过滤：题目要的是“支付当日生效”的历史档位，历史区间行 is_current=0（例如 S003 的 '2025-01-01'~'2026-10-04'），加 is_current=1 会把这些支付日错配到新费率。
- 关联键：shop_id。注意同一 shop_id 在窗口内可能因调档命中不同行（不同 contract_tier/费率），这正是题目“按支付当日生效档位”的语义，属预期行为；但需保证同一 (shop_id, 支付日) 只命中一行——若拉链表存在区间重叠，JOIN 会扇出放大订单金额，生成 SQL 前请确认 eff_start_dt~eff_end_dt 对 shop_id 不重叠（探查样本区间首尾相接无缝、无重叠）。
- 费率单位：comm_rate_bps 为【bps 万分比】INTEGER（样本 300~1250，即 3%~12.5%），必须换算为 comm_rate_bps / 10000.0 后参与乘法，切勿直接乘 bps 数值或除以 100。

【4. 最终聚合与计算】
- 建议三层结构：t_order（订单按 order_id、shop_id 聚合，含 pay_ts）→ LEFT/INNER JOIN dim_shop_commission_scd2 ON shop_id 且 substr(pay_ts,1,10) BETWEEN eff_start_dt AND eff_end_dt → LEFT JOIN t_refund（按 order_id 预聚合的 approved 退款额）ON order_id，再 GROUP BY contract_tier 汇总：gross_pay_yuan = ROUND(SUM(pay_yuan),2)，refund_yuan = ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(refund_yuan,0)),2)，net_comm_yuan = ROUND(SUM((pay_yuan - COALESCE(refund_yuan,0)) * comm_rate_bps/10000.0), 2)。

3. 从 dwd_refund_di 取 20261001~20261015 分区，仅保留 refund_status='approved'，按 order_id 预聚合已批准退款总额。
4. 以订单聚合结果为左表 LEFT JOIN 退款聚合结果，保证订单窗口内订单未被退款缺失过滤。
5. 按 contract_tier 汇总：实付总额 ROUND(SUM(pay_yuan),2)，退款总额 ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(refund_yuan,0)),2)，净抽佣按行级 (pay_yuan - refund_yuan) * comm_rate_bps/10000.0 先算后 SUM 再 ROUND(...,2)，最后按 contract_tier 升序。","sql":"SELECT
  c.contract_tier AS contract_tier,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_yuan), 2) AS gross_pay_yuan,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_yuan, 0)), 2) AS refund_yuan,
  ROUND(SUM((o.pay_yuan - COALESCE(r.refund_yuan, 0)) * c.comm_rate_bps / 10000.0), 2) AS net_comm_yuan
FROM (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    shop_id,
    SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_yuan,
    MAX(pay_ts) AS pay_ts
  FROM dwd_trade_order_di
  WHERE ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261012'
    AND order_status <> 'cancelled'
    AND pay_ts IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY order_id, shop_id
) o
JOIN dim_shop_commission_scd2 c
  ON o.shop_id = c.shop_id
 AND SUBSTR(o.pay_ts, 1, 10) BETWEEN c.eff_start_dt AND c.eff_end_dt
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(refund_amt) AS refund_yuan
  FROM dwd_refund_di
  WHERE ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015'
    AND refund_status = 'approved'
  GROUP BY order_id
) r
  ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY c.contract_tier
ORDER BY c.contract_tier ASC;"}

  "thought": "Grain: one row per main order (order_id). Step 1 — settle fact: filter partition ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015', dedupe incremental rows by settle_id (ROW_NUMBER ORDER BY ds DESC, rn=1) so repeated/updated清分 records do not double count, then keep settle_status_code='20_SETTLED' and is_test_acct=0 (probed codes from linker). Aggregate to order grain: SUM(settle_amt_cent), MAX(shop_id), order_dt normalized from 'yyyy-MM-dd' to yyyyMMdd with REPLACE(SUBSTR(TRIM(...),1,10),'-','') for SCD2 comparison. Step 2 — refund fact: partition dt BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015', dedupe by aftersale_id (latest dt), keep refund_status_code='02_REFUND_OK', pre-aggregate SUM(refund_amt_cent) per order_id in its own CTE, then LEFT JOIN to the order-level settle so order amounts never fan out. Step 3 — net base in cents: GREATEST(settle_amt_cent - NVL(refund_amt_cent,0), 0), floor at 0 per business rule; no unit conversion yet. Step 4 — SCD2 commission: normalize eff_start_dt/eff_end_dt to yyyyMMdd, blank/NULL end date -> '99991231'; LEFT JOIN on shop_id only, then ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_dt_norm BETWEEN eff_start_norm AND eff_end_norm THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, is_current DESC, eff_start_norm DESC, comm_scd_id DESC) and keep rn=1 so the version in effect on the actual order date (not merely is_current=1) is used; LEFT JOIN preserves orders lacking a version. Step 5 — final aggregation by contract_tier: order_cnt = COUNT(DISTINCT order_id); net_base_yuan = ROUND(SUM(net_base_cent)/100.0,2); net_comm_yuan = ROUND(SUM(net_base_cent * comm_rate_bps / 10000.0)/100.0,2) (bps /10000, cents /100 converted once at output). No status/flag filters beyond the probed codes; dim_shop not joined because no probed shop_type mapping for '外部/正式' was supplied. Order by contract_tier ASC.",
  "sql": "WITH settle_raw AS (
  SELECT settle_id,
         order_id,
         shop_id,
         order_dt,
         settle_amt_cent,
         settle_status_code,
         is_test_acct,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY settle_id ORDER BY ds DESC) AS rn
  FROM dwd_order_settle_di
  WHERE ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015'
),
settle_dedup AS (
  SELECT settle_id, order_id, shop_id, order_dt, settle_amt_cent
  FROM settle_raw
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND settle_status_code = '20_SETTLED'
    AND is_test_acct = 0
),
settle_ord AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         MAX(shop_id) AS shop_id,
         MAX(REPLACE(SUBSTR(TRIM(order_dt), 1, 10), '-', '')) AS order_dt_norm,
         SUM(settle_amt_cent) AS settle_amt_cent
  FROM settle_dedup
  GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_raw AS (
  SELECT aftersale_id,
         order_id,
         refund_amt_cent,
         refund_status_code,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY aftersale_id ORDER BY dt DESC) AS rn
  FROM dwd_aftersale_refund_di
  WHERE dt BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015'
),
refund_dedup AS (
  SELECT aftersale_id, order_id, refund_amt_cent
  FROM refund_raw
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND refund_status_code = '02_REFUND_OK'
),
refund_ord AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         SUM(refund_amt_cent) AS refund_amt_cent
  FROM refund_dedup
  GROUP BY order_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT s.order_id,
         s.shop_id,
         s.order_dt_norm,
         GREATEST(s.settle_amt_cent - NVL(r.refund_amt_cent, 0), 0) AS net_base_cent
  FROM settle_ord s
  LEFT JOIN refund_ord r
    ON s.order_id = r.order_id
),
comm AS (
  SELECT shop_id,
         contract_tier,
         comm_rate_bps,
         comm_scd_id,
         is_current,
         REPLACE(SUBSTR(TRIM(eff_start_dt), 1, 10), '-', '') AS eff_start_norm,
         CASE WHEN eff_end_dt IS NULL OR TRIM(eff_end_dt) = '' THEN '99991231'
              ELSE REPLACE(SUBSTR(TRIM(eff_end_dt), 1, 10), '-', '') END AS eff_end_norm
  FROM dim_shop_commission_scd2
),
base_comm AS (
  SELECT b.order_id,
         b.net_base_cent,
         c.contract_tier,
         c.comm_rate_bps,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY b.order_id
           ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.order_dt_norm BETWEEN c.eff_start_norm AND c.eff_end_norm THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                    NVL(c.is_current, 0) DESC,
                    c.eff_start_norm DESC,
                    c.comm_scd_id DESC
         ) AS rn

Business Hint: 输出列：city_tier, order_cnt, buyer_cnt, avg_buyer_settle_yuan（渠道实收总元/去重买家数，保留2位小数）。

  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

JOIN dim_shop d

Business Question: 结合交易订单明细表 dwd_trade_order_di（20261001 至 20261012 分区，非取消单）与退款表 dwd_refund_di（20261001 至 20261015 分区，refund_status = 'approved'），按订单支付当日生效的店铺签约档位（contract_tier）及费率，统计各档位的订单实付总额（元）、已批准退款总额（元）及扣退后净抽佣额（(订单实付 - 已批准退款) * 生效费率），按 contract_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：contract_tier, gross_pay_yuan, refund_yuan, net_comm_yuan（均保留2位小数）。

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_trade_order_di (DWD): 交易订单明细增量事实表（子订单粒度，同一order_id可能包含多条商品明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID（一单多品时对应多行）
  order_item_id VARCHAR  -- 子订单明细行ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 下单用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  item_id VARCHAR  -- 商品ID
  creator_id VARCHAR  -- 带货达人ID，非达人订单为NULL或空字符串
  order_status VARCHAR  -- 订单状态: paid/shipped/completed/cancelled
  qty INTEGER  -- 购买件数
  gross_amt DOUBLE  -- 应付原价金额
  discount_amt DOUBLE  -- 优惠金额，无优惠时为NULL
  pay_amt DOUBLE  -- 实付金额（取消单为0）
  pay_ts VARCHAR  -- 支付时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，未支付为NULL
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dwd_refund_di (DWD): 售后退款明细增量事实表（同一order_id可能存在多次部分退款）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  refund_id VARCHAR  -- 退款单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_amt DOUBLE  -- 退款金额
  refund_reason VARCHAR  -- 退款原因: quality/size_mismatch/late_delivery/buyer_remorse
  refund_status VARCHAR  -- 退款状态: approved/pending/rejected
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 退款日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

TABLE dwd_order_settle_di (DWD): 全端订单财务清分结算增量表（企业V2主单标准明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  settle_id VARCHAR  -- 清分单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  order_dt VARCHAR  -- 实际下单日期
  pay_channel_code VARCHAR  -- 支付渠道编码
  settle_status_code VARCHAR  -- 清分状态编码

  is_test_acct INTEGER  -- 内测压测账号标识
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

TABLE dwd_aftersale_refund_di (DWD): 售后逆向退赔单增量明细表
PARTITIONED BY (dt STRING)
  aftersale_id VARCHAR  -- 售后退赔单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_type_code VARCHAR  -- 售后退赔类型编码
  refund_status_code VARCHAR  -- 退赔状态编码

  shipping_comp_yuan DOUBLE  -- 保司运费险赔付额
  dt VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 分区日期

TABLE dim_shop (DIM): 商家店铺维表（非分区全量维表）
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺唯一ID
  shop_name VARCHAR  -- 店铺名称
  shop_type VARCHAR  -- 店铺类型: flagship/pop_store/cross_border/brand_direct
  main_cate VARCHAR  -- 主营一级类目
  open_dt VARCHAR  -- 开店日期 YYYY-MM-DD
  rating_score DOUBLE  -- 店铺综合评分

### Linker Schema Notes
表选择与分区：事实表 dwd_trade_order_di（分区列 ds，VARCHAR，格式 YYYYMMDD），题目已给固定区间，直接 ds BETWEEN '20260926' AND '20261008'，不要使用 MAX_PT（此题为显式历史区间）。

非取消订单口径：order_status 枚举值为 'paid','shipped','completed','cancelled'。非取消 = order_status <> 'cancelled'（或 IN ('paid','shipped','completed')）。不要额外加生命周期/渠道/有效状态谓词。pay_ts 为 VARCHAR 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'，未支付为 NULL；支付日期用 SUBSTR(pay_ts,1,10) 得到 'YYYY-MM-DD' 用于 SCD2 日期对齐；非取消交易需保证 pay_ts IS NOT NULL（“支付当日”口径）。

金额单位：pay_amt 为 DOUBLE，已是元（注释：实付金额（取消单为0）），无需 /100；输出 ka_pay_amt 用 ROUND(SUM(pay_amt),2)。“主订单数”用 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)。事实表为子订单/商品明细粒度，同一 order_id 可能多行；若先按订单聚合再关联维表必须 GROUP BY order_id 后 SUM(pay_amt)；若在明细行上过滤 KA 店铺，则 SUM 明细 pay_amt 同时 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)，并注意跨店铺订单的口径。

店铺签约档位关联：dim_shop_commission_scd2 为拉链表，contract_tier 取值 'CORE','KA','STD'，'KA' 即目标档位。eff_start_dt/eff_end_dt 为 'YYYY-MM-DD' 字符串，区间闭合。关联条件：o.shop_id = c.shop_id AND SUBSTR(o.pay_ts,1,10) BETWEEN c.eff_start_dt AND c.eff_end_dt AND c.contract_tier = 'KA'。不要用 is_current=1（应按支付当日历史版本匹配）。同一 shop_id 在同一日期应仅一条有效版本；关联前如担心多版本重叠，可按 shop_id+日期取唯一有效行。

会员等级关联：dim_user_vip_scd2 为拉链表，vip_tier 取值 'black_diamond','gold','normal','platinum','silver'。关联条件：o.user_id = v.user_id AND SUBSTR(o.pay_ts,1,10) BETWEEN v.eff_start_dt AND v.eff_end_dt；不要用 is_current=1。日期格式均为 'YYYY-MM-DD'，无需额外转换。

汇总与排序：按 v.vip_tier 分组，输出 vip_tier、COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS ka_order_cnt、ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amt),2) AS ka_pay_amt，ORDER BY vip_tier ASC。两维表均可能一 key 多历史行，必须用日期区间匹配避免笛卡尔放大。

PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  settle_id VARCHAR  -- 清分单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID

  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  order_dt VARCHAR  -- 实际下单日期

  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

TABLE dwd_aftersale_refund_di (DWD): 售后逆向退赔单增量明细表
PARTITIONED BY (dt STRING)
  aftersale_id VARCHAR  -- 售后退赔单ID

  shipping_comp_yuan DOUBLE  -- 保司运费险赔付额
  dt VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 分区日期

TABLE dim_shop (DIM): 商家店铺维表（非分区全量维表）
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺唯一ID

  main_cate VARCHAR  -- 主营一级类目

  rating_score DOUBLE  -- 店铺综合评分

Target Dialect: ODPS
Business Question: 在 20261008 至 20261014 清分分区内，统计非黑名单买家产生的正式外部商业化清分订单，按买家城市等级（city_tier）汇总订单数、去重买家数及买家平均渠道实收贡献额（元），按 city_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：city_tier, order_cnt, buyer_cnt, avg_buyer_settle_yuan（渠道实收总元/去重买家数，保留2位小数）。

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_order_settle_di (DWD): 全端订单财务清分结算增量表（企业V2主单标准明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  settle_id VARCHAR  -- 清分单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  order_dt VARCHAR  -- 实际下单日期
  pay_channel_code VARCHAR  -- 支付渠道编码
  settle_status_code VARCHAR  -- 清分状态编码
  gross_order_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 订单应付毛额(分)
  settle_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 渠道实收清分额(分)
  platform_subsidy_cent BIGINT  -- 平台补贴额(分)
  merchant_net_amt BIGINT  -- 商家实得清分净额
  is_test_acct INTEGER  -- 内测压测账号标识
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

TABLE dim_user (DIM): 用户基础维表（非分区全量维表）
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户唯一ID
  reg_dt VARCHAR  -- 注册日期 YYYY-MM-DD
  vip_level VARCHAR  -- 会员等级: normal/silver/gold/platinum
  city_tier VARCHAR  -- 城市线级: T1/T2/T3，存在NULL和空字符串
  gender VARCHAR  -- 性别: M/F，存在NULL和空字符串
  channel VARCHAR  -- 拉新渠道: organic/paid_ads/referral/live_stream
  is_blacklist INTEGER  -- 是否黑产风控用户: 0=正常, 1=黑名单

Business Question: 在 20261003 至 20261011 清分分区的正式外部商业化订单中，筛选出跨日延迟清分订单（即实际下单日期早于财务清分分区日期），按买家下单当日所处的会员等级（vip_tier）统计延迟清分单数与渠道实收总额（元），按 vip_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：vip_tier, lag_order_cnt, lag_settle_yuan（保留2位小数）。

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_order_settle_di (DWD): 全端订单财务清分结算增量表（企业V2主单标准明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  settle_id VARCHAR  -- 清分单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  order_dt VARCHAR  -- 实际下单日期
  pay_channel_code VARCHAR  -- 支付渠道编码
  settle_status_code VARCHAR  -- 清分状态编码
  gross_order_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 订单应付毛额(分)
  settle_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 渠道实收清分额(分)
  platform_subsidy_cent BIGINT  -- 平台补贴额(分)
  merchant_net_amt BIGINT  -- 商家实得清分净额
  is_test_acct INTEGER  -- 内测压测账号标识
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

TABLE dim_user_vip_scd2 (DIM): 用户会员等级变更拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  scd_id VARCHAR  -- 拉链记录ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  vip_tier VARCHAR  -- 会员等级
  growth_score INTEGER  -- 版本期初成长值
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_trade_order_di (DWD): 交易订单明细增量事实表（子订单粒度，同一order_id可能包含多条商品明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID（一单多品时对应多行）
  order_item_id VARCHAR  -- 子订单明细行ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 下单用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  item_id VARCHAR  -- 商品ID
  creator_id VARCHAR  -- 带货达人ID，非达人订单为NULL或空字符串
  order_status VARCHAR  -- 订单状态: paid/shipped/completed/cancelled
  qty INTEGER  -- 购买件数
  gross_amt DOUBLE  -- 应付原价金额
  discount_amt DOUBLE  -- 优惠金额，无优惠时为NULL
  pay_amt DOUBLE  -- 实付金额（取消单为0）
  pay_ts VARCHAR  -- 支付时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，未支付为NULL
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dwd_refund_di (DWD): 售后退款明细增量事实表（同一order_id可能存在多次部分退款）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  refund_id VARCHAR  -- 退款单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_amt DOUBLE  -- 退款金额
  refund_reason VARCHAR  -- 退款原因: quality/size_mismatch/late_delivery/buyer_remorse
  refund_status VARCHAR  -- 退款状态: approved/pending/rejected
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 退款日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_trade_order_di (DWD): 交易订单明细增量事实表（子订单粒度，同一order_id可能包含多条商品明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID（一单多品时对应多行）
  order_item_id VARCHAR  -- 子订单明细行ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 下单用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  item_id VARCHAR  -- 商品ID
  creator_id VARCHAR  -- 带货达人ID，非达人订单为NULL或空字符串
  order_status VARCHAR  -- 订单状态: paid/shipped/completed/cancelled
  qty INTEGER  -- 购买件数
  gross_amt DOUBLE  -- 应付原价金额
  discount_amt DOUBLE  -- 优惠金额，无优惠时为NULL
  pay_amt DOUBLE  -- 实付金额（取消单为0）
  pay_ts VARCHAR  -- 支付时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，未支付为NULL
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dwd_refund_di (DWD): 售后退款明细增量事实表（同一order_id可能存在多次部分退款）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  refund_id VARCHAR  -- 退款单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_amt DOUBLE  -- 退款金额
  refund_reason VARCHAR  -- 退款原因: quality/size_mismatch/late_delivery/buyer_remorse
  refund_status VARCHAR  -- 退款状态: approved/pending/rejected
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 退款日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

Target Dialect: ODPS
Business Question: 在 20260928 至 20261015 清分分区内的正式外部商业化订单中，筛选买家【实际下单当日】的会员等级与【当前最新】会员等级不同的订单，按下单当日的历史会员等级（hist_vip_tier）统计订单数与渠道实收总额（元），按 hist_vip_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：hist_vip_tier, changed_order_cnt, changed_settle_yuan（保留2位小数）。

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_order_settle_di (DWD): 全端订单财务清分结算增量表（企业V2主单标准明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  settle_id VARCHAR  -- 清分单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  order_dt VARCHAR  -- 实际下单日期
  pay_channel_code VARCHAR  -- 支付渠道编码
  settle_status_code VARCHAR  -- 清分状态编码
  gross_order_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 订单应付毛额(分)

  platform_subsidy_cent BIGINT  -- 平台补贴额(分)
  merchant_net_amt BIGINT  -- 商家实得清分净额
  is_test_acct INTEGER  -- 内测压测账号标识
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

TABLE dim_user_vip_scd2 (DIM): 用户会员等级变更拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  scd_id VARCHAR  -- 拉链记录ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  vip_tier VARCHAR  -- 会员等级
  growth_score INTEGER  -- 版本期初成长值
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

TABLE dim_shop (DIM): 商家店铺维表（非分区全量维表）
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺唯一ID
  shop_name VARCHAR  -- 店铺名称
  shop_type VARCHAR  -- 店铺类型: flagship/pop_store/cross_border/brand_direct
  main_cate VARCHAR  -- 主营一级类目
  open_dt VARCHAR  -- 开店日期 YYYY-MM-DD
  rating_score DOUBLE  -- 店铺综合评分

2) 时间口径：『实际下单当日』用 order_dt（VARCHAR，格式 'YYYY-MM-DD'，样例 '2026-10-12'），不要用 ds（清分日≠下单日）。
3) 金额单位：settle_amt_cent 为『渠道实收清分额(分)』BIGINT，转元需 settle_amt_cent/100.0；输出 settle_yuan = ROUND(SUM(settle_amt_cent)/100.0, 2)。注意勿用 merchant_net_amt（商家实得净额）或 gross_order_amt_cent（应付毛额）。
4) 过滤：正式外部商业化订单 → is_test_acct = 0（探测：is_test_acct ∈ {0,1}，1 为内测压测账号）。settle_status_code 已探测取值 {10_WAIT_CLEAR, 20_SETTLED, 90_REVERSED}，但问题未显式要求结算状态，**不要**加状态/翻转/渠道谓词。shop_type 已探测 {flagship, pop_store, cross_border, brand_direct}，未与『外部』建立确定映射，故不加 dim_shop 过滤与连接。
5) 会员等级归因：dim_user_vip_scd2（非分区全量拉链表）按 user_id + 下单日区间关联：JOIN dim_user_vip_scd2 v ON o.user_id = v.user_id AND o.order_dt >= v.eff_start_dt AND o.order_dt <= v.eff_end_dt。eff_start_dt/eff_end_dt 均为 'YYYY-MM-DD' VARCHAR，与 order_dt 格式一致，可直接字符串比较，无需 date_format 转换；末版本 eff_end_dt = '9999-12-31'，必须用闭区间 <= 才能覆盖当前版本，不可用 is_current=1 代替（会丢失历史当日等级）。vip_tier 取值样本 {normal, silver, gold, platinum, black_diamond}。
6) 粒度与去重：dwd_order_settle_di 为清分单粒度（settle_id 唯一，样例 order_id 与 settle_id 1:1）；同一 order_id 理论上可能因多次清分/冲正跨多个 ds 分区重复出现，若出现重复请先去重到 order_id 粒度（如按 MAX(ds) 取最新清分记录）再统计，避免 order_cnt 与 settle_yuan 双重计数。order_cnt 建议 COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)。

### Linker Schema Notes
1) 分区：dwd_trade_order_di 分区列为 ds(VARCHAR 'YYYYMMDD')，探到可用分区 20260925~20261015，题目区间 ds BETWEEN '20260926' AND '20261008' 可直接裁剪；使用静态字面量，ODPS 下亦可 MAX_PT('dwd_trade_order_di')，禁止 ds=(SELECT MAX(ds) ...)。两张 DIM 表为 UNPARTITIONED 全量维表。
2) 订单状态：order_status 实际取值仅有 'paid','shipped','completed','cancelled'（无其它隐藏码值）；非取消条件写作 order_status <> 'cancelled'（或 IN ('paid','shipped','completed')）。不要额外加支付状态/生命周期状态条件。
3) 粒度与去重（关键）：dwd_trade_order_di 为子订单粒度，同一 order_id 可能多行。必须先按 order_id 预聚合再统计：子查询 SELECT order_id, user_id, shop_id, MAX(pay_ts) AS pay_ts, SUM(pay_amt) AS order_pay_amt ... GROUP BY order_id, user_id, shop_id，然后 ka_order_cnt = COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)（或 COUNT(1) 于聚合结果上），ka_pay_amt = SUM(order_pay_amt)。切勿在外层直接 SUM(pay_amt) 同时 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) 而不做聚合，否则金额会被子订单重复累加口径混乱。
4) 金额单位：pay_amt 为 DOUBLE，已是元，无 /100 换算；取消单 pay_amt=0 且 pay_ts 为 NULL。仅统计 pay_ts IS NOT NULL 的已支付订单（非取消口径下自然成立，但保留该过滤以排除未支付）。输出 ROUND(SUM(...),2) 保留两位。
5) 店铺签约档位：dim_shop_commission_scd2.contract_tier 实际值为 'KA','CORE','STD'，'KA' 即直接字面值，无需编码映射；comm_rate_bps 为万分位但对本题无用。按“支付当日”取版本：JOIN ON o.shop_id = c.shop_id AND SUBSTR(o.pay_ts,1,10) >= c.eff_start_dt AND SUBSTR(o.pay_ts,1,10) <= c.eff_end_dt（eff_end_dt 为 '9999-12-31' 表示长期有效）；不要用 is_current=1 过滤（会错取当前版本而非支付当日版本），因区间不重叠每个 shop_id 每日仅一行。日期需先对齐为 'YYYY-MM-DD' 字符串再比较（pay_ts 为 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'）。
6) 会员等级：dim_user_vip_scd2.vip_tier 实际取值为 'normal','silver','gold','platinum','black_diamond'；同理按支付当日区间关联：JOIN ON o.user_id = v.user_id AND pay_date BETWEEN v.eff_start_dt AND v.eff_end_dt，不使用 is_current。该表 990 行、区间互斥，用户每日单版本。
7) 输出与排序：SELECT vip_tier, COUNT(...) AS ka_order_cnt, ROUND(SUM(order_pay_amt),2) AS ka_pay_amt ... GROUP BY vip_tier ORDER BY vip_tier ASC。不要对 vip_tier 加 IS NOT NULL/<>'' 过滤，不要加测试账号（订单表无 is_test_acct 字段，勿臆造）、风控或运营状态过滤。

    MAX(pay_ts) AS pay_ts,

       ELSE v.eff_end_dt
     END
GROUP BY v.vip_tier
ORDER BY v.vip_tier ASC

Business Question: 结合交易订单明细表 dwd_trade_order_di（20261001 至 20261012 分区，非取消单）与退款表 dwd_refund_di（20261001 至 20261015 分区，refund_status = 'approved'），按订单支付当日生效的店铺签约档位（contract_tier）及费率，统计各档位的订单实付总额（元）、已批准退款总额（元）及扣退后净抽佣额（(订单实付 - 已批准退款) * 生效费率），按 contract_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：contract_tier, gross_pay_yuan, refund_yuan, net_comm_yuan（均保留2位小数）。

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_trade_order_di (DWD): 交易订单明细增量事实表（子订单粒度，同一order_id可能包含多条商品明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID（一单多品时对应多行）
  order_item_id VARCHAR  -- 子订单明细行ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 下单用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  item_id VARCHAR  -- 商品ID
  creator_id VARCHAR  -- 带货达人ID，非达人订单为NULL或空字符串
  order_status VARCHAR  -- 订单状态: paid/shipped/completed/cancelled
  qty INTEGER  -- 购买件数
  gross_amt DOUBLE  -- 应付原价金额
  discount_amt DOUBLE  -- 优惠金额，无优惠时为NULL
  pay_amt DOUBLE  -- 实付金额（取消单为0）
  pay_ts VARCHAR  -- 支付时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，未支付为NULL
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dwd_refund_di (DWD): 售后退款明细增量事实表（同一order_id可能存在多次部分退款）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  refund_id VARCHAR  -- 退款单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_amt DOUBLE  -- 退款金额
  refund_reason VARCHAR  -- 退款原因: quality/size_mismatch/late_delivery/buyer_remorse
  refund_status VARCHAR  -- 退款状态: approved/pending/rejected
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 退款日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

Round only at the outer SELECT with ROUND(x, 2).

GRAIN / FAN-OUT (critical): dwd_trade_order_di is child-order-item grain -- one order_id has multiple rows (multiple order_item_id, and qty/gross_amt/discount_amt/pay_amt are per item). Pre-aggregate to order+shop before the tier join: SELECT order_id, shop_id, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt, SUBSTR(MIN(pay_ts),1,10) AS pay_date ... then group by order_id, shop_id, pay_date. dwd_refund_di is refund_id grain and an order_id can have MULTIPLE partial refunds (even two rows same order_id with different refund_status) -> pre-aggregate approved refunds per order_id FIRST: SUM(refund_amt) WHERE refund_status='approved' GROUP BY order_id. Never join item grain directly to refund grain (refund would be duplicated across items).

TIER / RATE JOIN (SCD2): dim_shop_commission_scd2 has multiple rows per shop_id (historical + current versions), so an is_current=1-only join is WRONG for historical pay dates. Join on shop_id AND point-in-time range using the order PAY DATE, not refund date, not ds: pay_date from pay_ts = SUBSTR(pay_ts,1,10) which yields 'YYYY-MM-DD', already aligned with eff_start_dt/eff_end_dt ('YYYY-MM-DD', open end sentinel '9999-12-31'). Therefore join approved-refund-per-order to the already-enriched order set on order_id (inner join) so every refund inherits its order's contract_tier/rate. Approved refunds whose order_id is absent from the filtered order set (outside 20261001-20261012) cannot be assigned a tier and are excluded -- state this caveat; likewise late refunds landing in partitions after 20261015 are out of scope.

PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)

    shop_id,

    SUBSTR(MIN(pay_ts), 1, 10) AS pay_date
  FROM dwd_trade_order_di

    AND order_status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY order_id, shop_id

  SELECT

    SUM(refund_amt) AS refund_amt
  FROM dwd_refund_di
  WHERE ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015'
    AND refund_status = 'approved'
  GROUP BY order_id
),
dim AS (
  SELECT
    shop_id,
    contract_tier,
    comm_rate_bps,
    eff_start_dt,
    eff_end_dt
  FROM (
    SELECT
      shop_id,
      contract_tier,
      comm_rate_bps,
      eff_start_dt,
      eff_end_dt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY shop_id, eff_start_dt
        ORDER BY is_current DESC, comm_scd_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM dim_shop_commission_scd2
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
ord_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.shop_id,
    o.pay_amt,
    o.pay_date,
    d.contract_tier,
    d.comm_rate_bps
  FROM ord o
  JOIN dim d
    ON o.shop_id = d.shop_id
   AND o.pay_date >= d.eff_start_dt
   AND o.pay_date <= CASE
                        WHEN d.eff_end_dt IS NULL OR d.eff_end_dt = '' THEN '9999-12-31'
                        ELSE d.eff_end_dt
                      END
),
order_net AS (
  SELECT
    e.contract_tier,
    e.pay_amt AS pay_amt,
    NVL(r.refund_amt, 0) AS refund_amt,
    (e.pay_amt - NVL(r.refund_amt, 0)) * (e.comm_rate_bps / 10000.0) AS net_comm
  FROM ord_enriched e
  LEFT JOIN ref r
    ON e.order_id = r.order_id
)
SELECT
  contract_tier,
  ROUND(SUM(pay_amt), 2) AS gross_pay_yuan,
  ROUND(SUM(refund_amt), 2) AS refund_yuan,
  ROUND(SUM(net_comm), 2) AS net_comm_yuan
FROM order_net
GROUP BY contract_tier
ORDER BY contract_tier ASC

Keep lag rows where actual order date is strictly before clearing partition date, normalizing ds yyyyMMdd and order_dt yyyy-MM-dd with TO_DATE. Build SCD2 VIP CTE, normalize empty/null eff_end_dt to 9999-12-31, deduplicate identical effective intervals by user_id/eff_start_dt/eff_end_dt using ROW_NUMBER ordered by is_current and scd_id. LEFT JOIN fact to VIP on user_id and order_dt BETWEEN eff_start_dt AND eff_end_dt inclusive, then ROW_NUMBER per clearing row (settle_id, ds) ordered by eff_start_dt DESC, is_current DESC, scd_id DESC to guarantee one effective tier per order date. Final aggregation groups by vip_tier, counts distinct order_id, sums settle_amt_cent/100.0 once and rounds to 2 decimals, orders vip_tier ascending. No settle_status or pay_channel filters are added.","sql":"WITH settle_lag AS (
  SELECT
    s.settle_id,
    s.order_id,
    s.user_id,
    s.order_dt,
    s.settle_amt_cent,
    s.ds
  FROM dwd_order_settle_di s
  WHERE s.ds BETWEEN '20261003' AND '20261011'
    AND s.is_test_acct = 0
    AND TO_DATE(s.order_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < TO_DATE(s.ds, 'yyyymmdd')
),
vip_scd AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    vip_tier,
    eff_start_dt,
    CASE
      WHEN eff_end_dt IS NULL OR eff_end_dt = '' THEN '9999-12-31'
      ELSE eff_end_dt
    END AS eff_end_dt,
    is_current,
    scd_id
  FROM dim_user_vip_scd2
),
vip_scd_dedup AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    vip_tier,
    eff_start_dt,
    eff_end_dt,
    is_current,
    scd_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      v.user_id,
      v.vip_tier,
      v.eff_start_dt,
      v.eff_end_dt,
      v.is_current,
      v.scd_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY v.user_id, v.eff_start_dt, v.eff_end_dt
        ORDER BY v.is_current DESC, v.scd_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM vip_scd v
  ) t
  WHERE t.rn = 1
),
settle_vip AS (
  SELECT
    l.settle_id,
    l.order_id,
    l.settle_amt_cent,
    v.vip_tier,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.settle_id, l.ds
      ORDER BY v.eff_start_dt DESC, v.is_current DESC, v.scd_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM settle_lag l
  LEFT JOIN vip_scd_dedup v
    ON l.user_id = v.user_id
   AND l.order_dt >= v.eff_start_dt
   AND l.order_dt <= v.eff_end_dt
)
SELECT
  sv.vip_tier AS vip_tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sv.order_id) AS lag_order_cnt,

WITH settle_lag AS (
  SELECT
    s.settle_id,
    s.order_id,
    s.user_id,
    s.order_dt,
    s.settle_amt_cent,
    s.ds
  FROM dwd_order_settle_di s
  WHERE s.ds BETWEEN '20261003' AND '20261011'
    AND s.is_test_acct = 0
    AND TO_DATE(s.order_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < TO_DATE(s.ds, 'yyyymmdd')
),
vip_scd AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    vip_tier,
    eff_start_dt,
    CASE
      WHEN eff_end_dt IS NULL OR eff_end_dt = '' THEN '9999-12-31'
      ELSE eff_end_dt
    END AS eff_end_dt,
    is_current,
    scd_id
  FROM dim_user_vip_scd2
),
vip_scd_dedup AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    vip_tier,
    eff_start_dt,
    eff_end_dt,
    is_current,
    scd_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      v.user_id,
      v.vip_tier,
      v.eff_start_dt,
      v.eff_end_dt,
      v.is_current,
      v.scd_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY v.user_id, v.eff_start_dt, v.eff_end_dt
        ORDER BY v.is_current DESC, v.scd_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM vip_scd v
  ) t
  WHERE t.rn = 1
),
settle_vip AS (
  SELECT
    l.settle_id,
    l.order_id,
    l.settle_amt_cent,
    v.vip_tier,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.settle_id, l.ds
      ORDER BY v.eff_start_dt DESC, v.is_current DESC, v.scd_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM settle_lag l
  LEFT JOIN vip_scd_dedup v
    ON l.user_id = v.user_id
   AND l.order_dt >= v.eff_start_dt
   AND l.order_dt <= v.eff_end_dt
)
SELECT
  sv.vip_tier AS vip_tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sv.order_id) AS lag_order_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(sv.settle_amt_cent) / 100.0, 2) AS lag_settle_yuan
FROM settle_vip sv
WHERE sv.rn = 1

Target Dialect: ODPS
Business Question: 针对 20261001 至 20261015 清分分区内“已结算”的正式外部商业化订单，扣减其在售后逆向退赔表同分区区间（20261001 至 20261015）内已“退赔成功”的退赔货款（单笔净基数不低于0），并按订单实际下单当日生效的店铺签约档位与费率计提净技术服务费，统计各 contract_tier 的已结算主单数、净结算基数总额（元）及净技术服务费总额（元），按 contract_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：contract_tier, order_cnt, net_base_yuan, net_comm_yuan（金额保留2位小数）。

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_order_settle_di (DWD): 全端订单财务清分结算增量表（企业V2主单标准明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  settle_id VARCHAR  -- 清分单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  order_dt VARCHAR  -- 实际下单日期
  pay_channel_code VARCHAR  -- 支付渠道编码
  settle_status_code VARCHAR  -- 清分状态编码
  gross_order_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 订单应付毛额(分)
  settle_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 渠道实收清分额(分)
  platform_subsidy_cent BIGINT  -- 平台补贴额(分)
  merchant_net_amt BIGINT  -- 商家实得清分净额
  is_test_acct INTEGER  -- 内测压测账号标识
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

TABLE dwd_aftersale_refund_di (DWD): 售后逆向退赔单增量明细表
PARTITIONED BY (dt STRING)
  aftersale_id VARCHAR  -- 售后退赔单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_type_code VARCHAR  -- 售后退赔类型编码
  refund_status_code VARCHAR  -- 退赔状态编码
  refund_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 退赔货款额
  shipping_comp_yuan DOUBLE  -- 保司运费险赔付额
  dt VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 分区日期

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

Business Question: 在 20260928 至 20261015 清分分区内的正式外部商业化订单中，筛选买家【实际下单当日】的会员等级与【当前最新】会员等级不同的订单，按下单当日的历史会员等级（hist_vip_tier）统计订单数与渠道实收总额（元），按 hist_vip_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：hist_vip_tier, changed_order_cnt, changed_settle_yuan（保留2位小数）。

Group by hist_vip_tier, count distinct order_id, sum settle_amt_cent / 100.0 rounded to 2 decimals, and order by hist_vip_tier ascending.","sql":"WITH order_base AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, order_dt, settle_amt_cent
  FROM (
    SELECT order_id, user_id, order_dt, settle_amt_cent,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY ds DESC, settle_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM dwd_order_settle_di
    WHERE ds BETWEEN '20260928' AND '20261015'
      AND is_test_acct = 0
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
hist_rank AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.order_dt, o.settle_amt_cent,
         h.vip_tier AS hist_vip_tier,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY o.order_id
           ORDER BY h.eff_start_dt DESC, h.eff_end_dt DESC, h.scd_id DESC
         ) AS rn_h
  FROM order_base o
  JOIN dim_user_vip_scd2 h
    ON o.user_id = h.user_id
   AND o.order_dt BETWEEN h.eff_start_dt AND h.eff_end_dt
),
order_hist AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, order_dt, settle_amt_cent, hist_vip_tier
  FROM hist_rank
  WHERE rn_h = 1
),
current_rank AS (
  SELECT user_id, vip_tier AS current_vip_tier,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY eff_start_dt DESC, scd_id DESC) AS rn_c
  FROM dim_user_vip_scd2
  WHERE is_current = 1
),
current_vip AS (
  SELECT user_id, current_vip_tier
  FROM current_rank
  WHERE rn_c = 1
)
SELECT oh.hist_vip_tier,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oh.order_id) AS changed_order_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(oh.settle_amt_cent / 100.0), 2) AS changed_settle_yuan
FROM order_hist oh
JOIN current_vip cv
  ON oh.user_id = cv.user_id
WHERE oh.hist_vip_tier <> cv.current_vip_tier
GROUP BY oh.hist_vip_tier
ORDER BY oh.hist_vip_tier ASC;"}

  GROUP BY shop_id

Business Question: 在交易订单明细表 dwd_trade_order_di 的 20260926 至 20261008 分区中，针对非取消订单，筛选支付当日店铺签约档位为 'KA' 的交易，按买家支付当日所处的会员等级（vip_tier）统计有效主订单数与实付总金额（元），按 vip_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：vip_tier, ka_order_cnt（主订单数）, ka_pay_amt（保留2位小数）。

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_trade_order_di (DWD): 交易订单明细增量事实表（子订单粒度，同一order_id可能包含多条商品明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID（一单多品时对应多行）
  order_item_id VARCHAR  -- 子订单明细行ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 下单用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  item_id VARCHAR  -- 商品ID
  creator_id VARCHAR  -- 带货达人ID，非达人订单为NULL或空字符串
  order_status VARCHAR  -- 订单状态: paid/shipped/completed/cancelled
  qty INTEGER  -- 购买件数
  gross_amt DOUBLE  -- 应付原价金额
  discount_amt DOUBLE  -- 优惠金额，无优惠时为NULL
  pay_amt DOUBLE  -- 实付金额（取消单为0）
  pay_ts VARCHAR  -- 支付时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，未支付为NULL
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

TABLE dim_user_vip_scd2 (DIM): 用户会员等级变更拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  scd_id VARCHAR  -- 拉链记录ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  vip_tier VARCHAR  -- 会员等级
  growth_score INTEGER  -- 版本期初成长值
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 版本生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

order_shop_dates AS (

        order_dt
    FROM filtered_orders

ranked_rates AS (
    SELECT
        o.shop_id,
        o.order_dt,
        r.comm_rate_bps,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.shop_id, o.order_dt

WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        shop_id,
        order_dt,
        settle_amt_cent
    FROM dwd_order_settle_di
    WHERE ds BETWEEN '20261002' AND '20261014'
      AND is_test_acct = 0
),
order_shop_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        shop_id,
        order_dt
    FROM filtered_orders
),
ranked_rates AS (
    SELECT
        o.shop_id,
        o.order_dt,
        r.comm_rate_bps,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.shop_id, o.order_dt
            ORDER BY r.eff_start_dt DESC, r.comm_scd_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM order_shop_dates o
    JOIN dim_shop_commission_scd2 r
      ON o.shop_id = r.shop_id
     AND o.order_dt BETWEEN r.eff_start_dt AND r.eff_end_dt
),
effective_rates AS (
    SELECT
        shop_id,
        order_dt,
        comm_rate_bps
    FROM ranked_rates
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    s.main_cate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(o.settle_amt_cent) / 100.0, 2) AS settle_yuan,
    ROUND(SUM(o.settle_amt_cent * r.comm_rate_bps / 1000000.0), 2) AS comm_fee_yuan
FROM filtered_orders o
JOIN effective_rates r
  ON o.shop_id = r.shop_id
 AND o.order_dt = r.order_dt
JOIN dim_shop s
  ON o.shop_id = s.shop_id
GROUP BY s.main_cate
ORDER BY s.main_cate ASC

Target Dialect: ODPS
Business Question: 结合交易订单明细表 dwd_trade_order_di（20261001 至 20261012 分区，非取消单）与退款表 dwd_refund_di（20261001 至 20261015 分区，refund_status = 'approved'），按订单支付当日生效的店铺签约档位（contract_tier）及费率，统计各档位的订单实付总额（元）、已批准退款总额（元）及扣退后净抽佣额（(订单实付 - 已批准退款) * 生效费率），按 contract_tier 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：contract_tier, gross_pay_yuan, refund_yuan, net_comm_yuan（均保留2位小数）。

### Selected Table Schemas
TABLE dwd_trade_order_di (DWD): 交易订单明细增量事实表（子订单粒度，同一order_id可能包含多条商品明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID（一单多品时对应多行）
  order_item_id VARCHAR  -- 子订单明细行ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 下单用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  item_id VARCHAR  -- 商品ID
  creator_id VARCHAR  -- 带货达人ID，非达人订单为NULL或空字符串
  order_status VARCHAR  -- 订单状态: paid/shipped/completed/cancelled
  qty INTEGER  -- 购买件数
  gross_amt DOUBLE  -- 应付原价金额
  discount_amt DOUBLE  -- 优惠金额，无优惠时为NULL
  pay_amt DOUBLE  -- 实付金额（取消单为0）
  pay_ts VARCHAR  -- 支付时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，未支付为NULL
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 交易日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dwd_refund_di (DWD): 售后退款明细增量事实表（同一order_id可能存在多次部分退款）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  refund_id VARCHAR  -- 退款单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_amt DOUBLE  -- 退款金额
  refund_reason VARCHAR  -- 退款原因: quality/size_mismatch/late_delivery/buyer_remorse
  refund_status VARCHAR  -- 退款状态: approved/pending/rejected
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 退款日分区 YYYYMMDD

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

表与分区：dwd_order_settle_di 分区列为 ds，取最新清分日使用 ds = MAX_PT('dwd_order_settle_di')（本次探测最新分区为 '20261015'，禁止写成 ds = (SELECT MAX(ds) ...)）；dwd_aftersale_refund_di 分区列为 dt，题目指定范围 dt BETWEEN '20261012' AND '20261015'（分区值为字符串，不加引号会报错）；dim_shop 为非分区全量维表。

状态码映射：dwd_order_settle_di.settle_status_code 中“已结算”= '20_SETTLED'（其他值包含 '10_WAIT_CLEAR'、'90_REVERSED'，因题目明确要求已结算主单，仅保留 '20_SETTLED'，不要额外排除 90_REVERSED 作为独立条件，已由该等值条件覆盖）；dwd_aftersale_refund_di.refund_status_code 中“退赔成功”= '02_REFUND_OK'（其他值 '01_APPLY'、'03_REJECTED' 不纳入成功退赔）。refund_type_code 无需过滤，题目未限定退赔类型。

“正式外部商业化”口径：仅映射到测试账号排除标识 dwd_order_settle_di.is_test_acct = 0（0/1 取值，0 表示正式非内测压测账号）；pay_channel_code 未探测到正式/外部映射，题目未要求渠道过滤，禁止增加支付渠道、生命周期或经营状态过滤。

连接键与粒度：主口径订单来自 dwd_order_settle_di，主键/连接键为 order_id；dwd_aftersale_refund_di 同一 order_id 可能存在多条退赔记录（多种 refund_type_code、多个状态），必须先在 dt BETWEEN '20261012' AND '20261015' 且 refund_status_code = '02_REFUND_OK' 条件下按 order_id 去重（SELECT DISTINCT order_id 或 GROUP BY order_id），再与已结算主单 LEFT JOIN，否则会放大已结算主单数。店铺维度通过 dim_shop.shop_id = dwd_order_settle_di.shop_id 关联，取 shop_type，粒度为一店一行；若担心维表重复，可先按 shop_id 去重。结算表为增量表，最新 ds 分区内建议按 order_id 去重后再统计，确保 settled_order_cnt = COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)。

指标与单位：settled_order_cnt = 最新清分日分区内 settle_status_code='20_SETTLED' 且 is_test_acct=0 的去重主订单数；refunded_order_cnt = 上述主订单中在售后退赔表指定分区内存在 refund_status_code='02_REFUND_OK' 记录的去重主订单数；order_refund_rate = refunded_order_cnt / settled_order_cnt，需做除零保护（如 CASE WHEN settled_order_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE ... END），并 CAST 为 DECIMAL 后 ROUND(...,4) 输出 4 位小数。金额字段本次未使用，无需分转元换算。结果按 dim_shop.shop_type 升序排列。

Previous SQL:
WITH settle_orders AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        MAX(shop_id) AS shop_id
    FROM dwd_order_settle_di
    WHERE ds = MAX_PT('dwd_order_settle_di')
      AND settle_status_code = '20_SETTLED'
      AND is_test_acct = 0
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id
    FROM dwd_aftersale_refund_di
    WHERE dt BETWEEN '20261012' AND '20261015'
      AND refund_status_code = '02_REFUND_OK'
),
shop_dim AS (
    SELECT
        shop_id,
        MAX(shop_type) AS shop_type
    FROM dim_shop
    GROUP BY shop_id
)
SELECT
    d.shop_type AS shop_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS settled_order_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.order_id END) AS refunded_order_cnt,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND(
                CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.order_id END) AS DECIMAL(20,8))
                / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS DECIMAL(20,8)),
                4
            )
        END AS DECIMAL(20,4)
    ) AS order_refund_rate
FROM settle_orders s
JOIN shop_dim d
  ON s.shop_id = d.shop_id
LEFT JOIN refund_orders r
  ON s.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY d.shop_type
ORDER BY d.shop_type ASC

TABLE dwd_order_settle_di (DWD): 全端订单财务清分结算增量表（企业V2主单标准明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  settle_id VARCHAR  -- 清分单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  order_dt VARCHAR  -- 实际下单日期
  pay_channel_code VARCHAR  -- 支付渠道编码
  settle_status_code VARCHAR  -- 清分状态编码
  gross_order_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 订单应付毛额(分)

  platform_subsidy_cent BIGINT  -- 平台补贴额(分)
  merchant_net_amt BIGINT  -- 商家实得清分净额
  is_test_acct INTEGER  -- 内测压测账号标识
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

TABLE dwd_aftersale_refund_di (DWD): 售后逆向退赔单增量明细表
PARTITIONED BY (dt STRING)
  aftersale_id VARCHAR  -- 售后退赔单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 关联主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  refund_type_code VARCHAR  -- 售后退赔类型编码
  refund_status_code VARCHAR  -- 退赔状态编码
  refund_amt_cent BIGINT  -- 退赔货款额
  shipping_comp_yuan DOUBLE  -- 保司运费险赔付额
  dt VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 分区日期

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  comm_scd_id VARCHAR  -- 费率版本ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  contract_tier VARCHAR  -- 商业化签约档位
  comm_rate_bps INTEGER  -- 技术服务费率(bps)
  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

WITH settle_order AS (
  SELECT
    s.order_id,
    MAX(s.shop_id) AS shop_id,
    MAX(s.order_dt) AS order_dt,
    SUM(s.settle_amt_cent) AS settle_amt_cent
  FROM dwd_order_settle_di s
  WHERE s.ds BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015'
    AND s.settle_status_code = '20_SETTLED'
    AND s.is_test_acct = 0
  GROUP BY s.order_id
),
refund_agg AS (
  SELECT
    a.order_id,
    SUM(a.refund_amt_cent) AS refund_amt_cent
  FROM dwd_aftersale_refund_di a
  WHERE a.dt BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261015'
    AND a.refund_status_code = '02_REFUND_OK'
  GROUP BY a.order_id
),
order_base AS (
  SELECT
    so.order_id,
    so.shop_id,
    so.order_dt,
    so.settle_amt_cent,
    COALESCE(ra.refund_amt_cent, 0) AS refund_amt_cent,
    CASE
      WHEN so.settle_amt_cent - COALESCE(ra.refund_amt_cent, 0) > 0
        THEN so.settle_amt_cent - COALESCE(ra.refund_amt_cent, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END AS net_base_cent
  FROM settle_order so
  LEFT JOIN refund_agg ra
    ON so.order_id = ra.order_id
),
order_rate AS (
  SELECT
    ob.order_id,
    ob.shop_id,
    ob.order_dt,
    ob.net_base_cent,
    d.contract_tier,
    d.comm_rate_bps,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ob.order_id
      ORDER BY d.eff_start_dt DESC, d.is_current DESC, d.comm_scd_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM order_base ob
  JOIN dim_shop_commission_scd2 d
    ON ob.shop_id = d.shop_id
   AND ob.order_dt >= d.eff_start_dt
   AND ob.order_dt <= CASE
         WHEN d.eff_end_dt IS NULL OR d.eff_end_dt = '' THEN '9999-12-31'
         ELSE d.eff_end_dt
       END
)
SELECT
  x.contract_tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT x.order_id) AS order_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(x.net_base_cent / 100.0), 2) AS net_base_yuan,
  ROUND(SUM((x.net_base_cent / 100.0) * (x.comm_rate_bps / 10000.0)), 2) AS net_comm_yuan
FROM order_rate x
WHERE x.rn = 1
GROUP BY x.contract_tier
ORDER BY x.contract_tier ASC

Target Dialect: ODPS
Business Question: 在 20261002 至 20261014 清分分区内的正式外部商业化订单中，按实际下单当日生效的店铺技术服务费率计提抽佣服务费，关联店铺维表按主营类目（main_cate）统计订单数、渠道实收总额（元）与抽佣服务费总额（元），按 main_cate 升序排列。
Business Hint: 输出列：main_cate, order_cnt, settle_yuan, comm_fee_yuan（金额保留2位小数）。

TABLE dwd_order_settle_di (DWD): 全端订单财务清分结算增量表（企业V2主单标准明细）
PARTITIONED BY (ds STRING)
  settle_id VARCHAR  -- 清分单ID
  order_id VARCHAR  -- 主订单ID
  user_id VARCHAR  -- 买家用户ID
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺ID
  order_dt VARCHAR  -- 实际下单日期

  settle_status_code VARCHAR  -- 清分状态编码

  merchant_net_amt BIGINT  -- 商家实得清分净额
  is_test_acct INTEGER  -- 内测压测账号标识
  ds VARCHAR [PARTITION KEY]  -- 财务清分日分区

TABLE dim_shop_commission_scd2 (DIM): 店铺签约抽佣费率拉链表

  eff_start_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效开始日
  eff_end_dt VARCHAR  -- 生效结束日
  is_current INTEGER  -- 当前有效标识

TABLE dim_shop (DIM): 商家店铺维表（非分区全量维表）
-- Non-partitioned dimension table
  shop_id VARCHAR  -- 店铺唯一ID
  shop_name VARCHAR  -- 店铺名称

  main_cate VARCHAR  -- 主营一级类目
  open_dt VARCHAR  -- 开店日期 YYYY-MM-DD
  rating_score DOUBLE  -- 店铺综合评分

### Linker Schema Notes
1) 事实表 dwd_trade_order_di：分区列 ds，格式 YYYYMMDD，本问题直接写死范围 ds BETWEEN '20260926' AND '20261008'（不要用 MAX_PT，因是显式区间）。粒度为子订单(order_item_id)级，同一 order_id 可能多行：必须先按 order_id 预聚合 SUM(pay_amt) 得到主订单实付额，再统计 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) 作为 ka_order_cnt，金额 SUM 在订单级汇总后再求和，避免一单多品重复计数。2) 订单状态：order_status 取值 paid/shipped/completed/cancelled；'非取消订单' = order_status <> 'cancelled'。pay_amt 为 DOUBLE 且已是元（取消单为 0），无需 /100 换算；最终 ROUND(SUM(...), 2) 输出 ka_pay_amt。3) pay_ts 为 VARCHAR 格式 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'（未支付为 NULL）；'支付当日' = SUBSTR(pay_ts,1,10)，且必须过滤 pay_ts IS NOT NULL（后续按支付日做拉链关联所需，不属于额外业务过滤）。4) 店铺签约档位：dim_shop_commission_scd2.contract_tier 直接含 'KA' 字面值（另见 CORE/STD），无需编码映射；'支付当日店铺签约档位' 用 as-of 关联：t.shop_id = c.shop_id AND SUBSTR(t.pay_ts,1,10) BETWEEN c.eff_start_dt AND c.eff_end_dt（日期均为 'YYYY-MM-DD' 字符串，可直接比较，eff_end_dt 含当日，长期有效为 '9999-12-31'）。禁止用 is_current = 1 代替日期区间（会漏历史版本）。5) 会员等级：dim_user_vip_scd2.vip_tier 取值 normal/silver/gold/platinum/black_diamond；'支付当日所处等级' 同样 as-of 关联：t.user_id = v.user_id AND SUBSTR(t.pay_ts,1,10) BETWEEN v.eff_start_dt AND v.eff_end_dt，禁止用 is_current=1。6) 两张拉链表对同一 shop_id/user_id 存在多版本行，必须靠日期区间裁剪到唯一版本后再 join，否则订单金额会被放大；若担心数据重叠，可先在子查询中按 shop_id/user_id + 支付日去重（如 ROW_NUMBER 取一版）。7) 不要额外附加 is_test_acct、is_blacklist、op_status_code 等状态/风控谓词，问题未要求。8) 输出：GROUP BY vip_tier，ka_order_cnt = COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)（主订单数），ka_pay_amt = ROUND(SUM(订单级实付),2)，ORDER BY vip_tier ASC。

WITH item_base AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    user_id,
    shop_id,
    SUBSTR(pay_ts, 1, 10) AS pay_date,
    SUM(pay_amt) AS order_pay_amt
  FROM dwd_trade_order_di
  WHERE ds BETWEEN '20260926' AND '20261008'
    AND order_status <> 'cancelled'
    AND pay_ts IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id, shop_id, SUBSTR(pay_ts, 1, 10)
),
distinct_shop_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, pay_date FROM item_base
),
shop_dedup AS (
  SELECT
    d.shop_id,
    d.pay_date,
    c.contract_tier,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.shop_id, d.pay_date
      ORDER BY c.eff_start_dt DESC, c.is_current DESC, c.comm_scd_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM distinct_shop_dates d
  LEFT JOIN dim_shop_commission_scd2 c
    ON d.shop_id = c.shop_id
   AND d.pay_date BETWEEN c.eff_start_dt
       AND CASE WHEN c.eff_end_dt IS NULL OR c.eff_end_dt = '' THEN '9999-12-31' ELSE c.eff_end_dt END
),
ka_orders AS (
  SELECT
    t.order_id,
    t.user_id,
    t.shop_id,
    t.pay_date,
    t.order_pay_amt
  FROM item_base t
  JOIN shop_dedup s
    ON t.shop_id = s.shop_id
   AND t.pay_date = s.pay_date
  WHERE s.rn = 1
    AND s.contract_tier = 'KA'
),
distinct_user_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, pay_date FROM ka_orders
),
user_vip_dedup AS (
  SELECT
    d.user_id,
    d.pay_date,
    v.vip_tier,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.user_id, d.pay_date
      ORDER BY v.eff_start_dt DESC, v.is_current DESC, v.scd_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM distinct_user_dates d
  LEFT JOIN dim_user_vip_scd2 v
    ON d.user_id = v.user_id
   AND d.pay_date BETWEEN v.eff_start_dt
       AND CASE WHEN v.eff_end_dt IS NULL OR v.eff_end_dt = '' THEN '9999-12-31' ELSE v.eff_end_dt END
),
final_orders AS (
  SELECT
    k.order_id,
    k.user_id,
    k.shop_id,
    k.pay_date,
    k.order_pay_amt,
    u.vip_tier
  FROM ka_orders k
  JOIN user_vip_dedup u
    ON k.user_id = u.user_id
   AND k.pay_date = u.pay_date
   AND u.rn = 1
)
SELECT
  vip_tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS ka_order_cnt,
  ROUND(SUM(order_pay_amt), 2) AS ka_pay_amt
FROM final_orders
GROUP BY vip_tier
ORDER BY vip_tier ASC
